_meta.description: Alliance-sourced cheat sheets: troop comps, hero lineups, event timing.
_meta.sourceNote: Comp guides cross-checked against kingshotguide.org, kingshotmastery.com, kingshotwiki.com. SQB should verify against alliance practice.

guides.title: Bear Trap — Rally Lead
guides.summary: Best heroes & troop split when you are leading the rally

blocks.title: Best heroes (Gen 3 lead)
items: Best overall: Amadeus · Petra · Merlin
Low-spender alt: Zoe · Petra · Merlin
F2P fallback: Zoe · Jabel · Quinn
Use attack/rally widgets — not economy heroes (don't use Diana over Quinn)

blocks.text: 5,000 Infantry floor (Gen 4+): At 1/10/89, check absolute troop count — if 1% is under 5,000 infantry, bump infantry % until you're above the floor or damage gets penalized.

blocks.title: Leader checklist
items: Fill rally to your max capacity — leader sets total troop cap.
Bear deals no return damage; prioritize archer-weighted damage over survival.
Coordinate with R4/R5 on how many rallies to run vs how many joiners are online.
Upgrade Bear Trap building — each level adds +5% attack to all troop types in the event.

guides.note: Widgets matter for rally lead. Marlin (attack widget) beats Jaeger on rally lead even though Jaeger has higher raw stats for solo marches.

guides.title: Bear Trap — Joining Rallies
guides.summary: Joiner heroes, troop splits & the 2–3 vs 4–5 rally question

blocks.title: How joiners actually work
blocks.body: Joiners contribute their own troops (which inherit the leader's stats/buffs) plus only the 1st skill of their 1st hero. The game picks the top 4 highest-level joiner skills across the whole rally. Hero slot order beyond #1 does not matter for joiners.

rows: Flat lethality / attack buffs — stack multiplicatively
Amane, Margot, Vivian, Wee & Woo, Ava
Pairs well with Chenko-type; don't stack duplicates blindly
Defensive or economy skills can displace a good damage skill
Valid and often correct — see strategy below

blocks.title: Joiner troop ratio
blocks.body: Send 0% infantry as a joiner. Split capacity 20% cavalry / 80% archers (e.g. 14K cav + 55K arch on a 69K march). Your troops still count toward personal damage score and help the rally.

blocks.title: 2–3 full rallies vs 4–5 thin rallies?
items: Fewer, fuller rallies usually win when coordination allows. Top-4 joiner skill cap means spreading heroes across 5 rallies dilutes buffs.
R4/R5 count online joiners with S-tier heroes before opening rallies.
Run 2–3 rallies with full troops + assigned Chenko/Amadeus/Yeonwoo until top-4 skills are filled.
Once 4 strong joiner skills are locked, extra members send troops only — never a bad hero.
Open a 4th/5th rally only if unused S-tier joiners remain AND troops can fill it.
Hero + no troops? Rarely worth it — sacrifices personal score and rally mass.
Hero + troops in many rallies? Only if each rally gets a unique high-level joiner skill.

blocks.text: Alliance callout in chat: "Rally 1 needs Chenko + Amadeus — who's got Yeonwoo? Everyone else troops-only unless asked."

guides.title: Attack Rallies — Castles & Structures
guides.summary: Hero lineups & formations for taking keeps, turrets & outposts

rows: Attack first — see garrison guide for 2nd rally

blocks.title: Attack joiners
blocks.body: Stack offensive joiner skills like Bear Trap: 2× Chenko + 2× Amane is the damage ceiling; 4× Chenko is easier to coordinate. Joiner troops inherit leader stats — send a full march when you can.

blocks.title: Castle / structure tips
items: Use attack widgets on rally lead — check hero gear before launching.
Scout the garrison comp when possible and counter infantry-heavy setups with more archers.
Double-rally: attack rally lands first; garrison rally ~5 seconds behind (separate guide).
Special buildings (turrets, outposts) use the same attack logic — infantry-heavy defenders mean more archers.

guides.title: Garrison & Defense — PvP
guides.summary: Holding castles, structures & reinforcing allies under attack

rows: ~2.24× Defense Up (two def types on one skill)
When leadership assigns a non-hero reinforcement slot

blocks.title: Garrison joiner mechanics
blocks.body: Garrison strength comes from stacking the same defensive skill type across joiners — not from one superstar lead. Mismatched joiner heroes waste slots. Follow R4/R5 assignments; default to Saul if unsure.

blocks.title: While holding a structure
items: Watch infantry count — if it drops, queue an infantry-heavy reinforcement rally.
Use garrison/defender widgets on lead heroes, not attack widgets.
Voice chat helps for double-rally timing and reinforcement calls.
If attack rally captures first, recall attack heroes before garrison lands so defenders swap in.

guides.note: Reinforcing an ally's city under PvP attack = same garrison joiner logic (Saul/Gordon stack). See Vikings guide for Viking Vengeance — different goal (kills vs survival).

guides.title: Viking Vengeance — Reinforcement
guides.summary: NOT the same as PvP garrison — optimize for kills, not survival

blocks.text: Key difference from PvP garrison: Vikings score on kills, not holding. Use Bear Hunt lethality heroes when reinforcing allies — NOT Howard/Gordon/Saul defensive stacks.

rows: Infantry first, then cavalry — skip archers early
Empty city — let reinforcements get kills

blocks.title: Viking rules of thumb
items: Send infantry/cavalry out to reinforce — troops at home earn almost nothing.
After wave 9 / 19 ends, pull one march back for HQ defense on wave 10 / 20, then return to reinforcing.
Waves 7, 14, 17 hit online players only — prioritize reinforcing active members before those.
Gen 3 Guard Station example: Amadeus · Jabel · Saul (adjust to your roster).

guides.title: Resource Gathering — Heroes & Marches
guides.summary: One Rare hero per resource; 100% single troop type per march

blocks.title: Troop setup
blocks.body: Send 100% of one troop type per march (not a combat split). Use your highest load-tier troops so the node clears in one trip. Match gathering research buffs to the troop type you're sending when possible.

blocks.title: Efficiency tips
items: Target level 6–8 tiles when your march capacity allows — higher yield per trip.
Send enough troops to clear the node in one trip; partial loads waste time.
Inside alliance territory = gathering speed bonus from alliance tech.
Early game: Gordon (+25% speed & +25% march capacity) until blue heroes are leveled.
Planning ratio for stockpiles: roughly 20 bread : 20 wood : 4 stone : 1 iron.

guides.note: During gathering events, match the hero to the resource the event scores — verify the live task list before committing all marches.

guides.title: Troop Formations — Quick Reference
guides.summary: One-page ratio lookup by activity & generation

blocks.text: Format is Infantry / Cavalry / Archers. Save these as march presets before events — don't build comps mid-fight. Counter-scout before deviating from defaults.

blocks.title: Hero pairing hints (Gen 3)
items: Bear lead: 2 archer heroes + 1 rally buff hero at 10/10/80
Attack rally: Amadeus · Petra · Marlin at 50/20/30
Garrison: Eric · Jaeger · Hilde at 60/15/25 + Saul joiner stack
Solo / AC: Amadeus · Petra · Jaeger (widgets don't apply)

guides.title: Formation Presets — What to Save (1–8 Slots)
guides.summary: Priority order for saved march formations on a Gen 3 account

blocks.title: How to read this
blocks.body: Assumes an active Gen 3 alliance member (Bear every 2 days, some PvP, occasional AC/Vikings). Slots = saved troop ratios; swap heroes at send time. Priority = frequency × cost of getting it wrong × how unique the split is.

rows: Chenko · Amadeus · Yeonwoo — or troops only
Bear Trap joins (most members join more than lead)
Attack: Amadeus · Petra · Marlin · Solo/AC: Amadeus · Petra · Jaeger
Attack rallies, castle/turrets/outposts, solo PvP, Alliance Championship
Castle, outposts, flags, PvP ally reinforce
Map gathering — highest load tier, one resource per preset
KvK stall, emergency city defense, SOS reinforce
Viking Vengeance ally reinforce (kills, not hold)

blocks.text: Slot 1 swap: If you lead bears more than you join, make slot 1 Bear lead 10/10/80 and bump joiner to slot 3.

blocks.title: Don't waste slots — these share one preset
items: Attack rally = AC = solo PvP = outpost attack → all 50/20/30
Castle garrison ≈ outpost hold → both 60/15/25
Bear lead, bear join, gather, and Viking reinforce each need their own slot

blocks.title: Role variants
items: Join bears only, never lead: 1 Join → 2 Attack → 3 Garrison (skip bear lead until slot 4+).
R4/R5 bear lead: 1 Lead → 2 Attack → 3 Join.
Gather/farm alt: Move Gathering to slot 2 or 3 if the account rarely fights.
Slot 8 alt: Counter vs cavalry 60/10/30 instead of Viking preset if you scout PvP often and rarely play Vikings.

blocks.text: Gen 4 prep: Replace bear lead with 1/10/89 and verify the 5,000 infantry floor. Joiner stays 0/20/80.

blocks.title: How AC differs from rally PvP
blocks.body: Alliance Championship fights are solo marches — widgets do not apply. Pick heroes on raw stats, not rally widgets. Your buffs are snapshotted at registration (pets, alliance tech, consumables) and locked for the whole event.

rows: Activate pet skills, combat buffs, appointments first
Leadership moves you — register your best once

blocks.title: Lane strategy (alliance coordination)
items: Main lane (~20 fighters): Top power — win outright, max eliminations (2-cap per march).
Second lane (~20 fighters): Also built to win — losing both priority lanes loses the round.
Sacrifice lane: Stall, waste enemy eliminations, preserve buffers. Minimal consumables.
Round 1: spread for intel. Later rounds: reassign based on battle reports.

blocks.text: 50/20/30 is the baseline — R4/R5 may call 6/2/2 or counter-builds after scouting. Don't freelancing a weird split without approval.

guides.title: Swordland Showdown
guides.summary: Roles, building priority & when defense heroes beat attack heroes

blocks.title: Event basics
blocks.body: Bi-weekly 1-hour alliance PvP battlefield. Score Relic Points from buildings, baggage trains, undercellars, and kills. Troops are injured only (no permadeath). Personal rank rewards often matter as much as the alliance win.

rows: Garrison leads — Eric · Jaeger · Hilde, 60/20/20. Howard + Quinn classic duo (−40% damage taken)
Offensive solo marches — hunt enemy troops, burn cities off buildings
Join garrisons, gather scattered points, undercellars, baggage trains

blocks.title: Building capture priority
items: 1. Royal Stables — halves teleport cooldown (capture first)
2. Bell Tower — halves capture time on everything else
3. Sanctums — point engine; hold both if possible
4. Abbeys — fill remaining marches
5. @ 15 min: Hall of Reformation (+15% dmg/def), Merc Camp, Swordshrine opens — Reformation is high value; don't tunnel Swordshrine alone

blocks.text: Voice chat + map labels from R4/R5. If outmatched, farm personal Relic Points rather than throwing everything at unwinnable fights.

guides.title: Outposts, Flags & Territory
guides.summary: Same comp logic as castle — with widget nuance for solo garrison

blocks.title: Same as castle battle?
blocks.body: Mostly yes. Attack rallies on outposts/flags use the same attack heroes and 50/20/30 default as castle/turret fights. Garrison uses Eric · Jaeger · Hilde at 60/15/25 with Saul/Gordon joiner stacks.

rows: Same — defensive widgets activate even solo

blocks.text: Widget note: Defensive widgets activate when garrisoning rallyable locations (outpost, flag, node) — even if you're alone. Use defender-widget heroes here, not attack widgets.

blocks.title: Territory tips
items: Reinforcing an ally's outpost under attack = PvP garrison rules (Saul stack), not Viking rules.
Scout the garrison before attacking — swap to 30/20/50 vs infantry-heavy defenders.
Double-rally still applies: attack to dislodge, garrison rally ~5s behind.

rows: Widgets don't apply — raw stats win
Same as solo; prep preset saves time

blocks.text: Rule of thumb: Rally/garrison = check widgets. Solo = ignore widgets, pick highest stat heroes.

guides.title: Mystic Trial — Troop Compositions
guides.note: Use the fallback ratio (62/6/32) if a zone-specific comp isn't working.

guides.title: Golden Glaives — Watchtower Timing
guides.summary: Complete-but-don't-claim strategy to carry Watchtower rewards into event scoring
guides.note: Complete the 08:00 tasks but don't claim — hold the reward. Skip 16:00 entirely so those tasks are fresh at Monday's event-start reset. Claim everything at 00:00 Monday when Golden Glaives scoring goes live.
